name: Isolated Idiopathic Anterior Uveitis

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Standard Clinical Diagnostic Criteria for Anterior Uveitis

criteria.description: Presence of inflammatory cells and flare in the anterior chamber on slit-lamp examination
No evidence of systemic autoimmune or infectious disease after appropriate evaluation
Negative laboratory and clinical workup for infectious etiologies such as herpes, tuberculosis, syphilis
Symptoms and signs consistent with anterior uveitis including eye redness, pain, photophobia, and decreased vision

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of anterior chamber inflammation with exclusion of systemic and infectious causes
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is clinical and requires exclusion of secondary causes.

searchTerms: eye inflammation with cells in front chamber

pathognomonic.symptomName: Eye redness localized to the conjunctiva

occasional.symptomName: Hypopyon (layering of white blood cells in anterior chamber)
searchTerms: eye infection with white cell layering

occasional.symptomName: Posterior synechiae (adhesions between iris and lens)

rare.symptomName: Cataract formation secondary to chronic inflammation
searchTerms: eye lens opacity due to chronic irritation

laboratory: Normal systemic inflammatory markers (ESR, CRP) in isolated cases
Negative infectious serologies (e.g., syphilis, tuberculosis, herpes simplex virus)
Negative autoimmune markers (ANA, HLA-B27 negative in many cases)
imaging: Slit-lamp biomicroscopy showing anterior chamber cells and flare
Optical coherence tomography (OCT) may show macular edema if present
genetic: No consistent genetic markers identified; HLA-B27 negative in many idiopathic cases
other: Clinical exclusion of systemic autoimmune or infectious diseases

distinguishingFeatures: Often recurrent and linked to spondyloarthropathies
May have systemic symptoms such as back pain
Presence of keratic precipitates typical for herpes or syphilis

redFlags: Elevated intraocular pressure refractory to treatment
references: Jabs DA, Nussenblatt RB, Rosenbaum JT. Standardization of Uveitis Nomenclature for Reporting Clinical Data. Am J Ophthalmol. 2005.
Nussenblatt RB. The natural history of uveitis. Int Ophthalmol. 1990.
Orphanet: Isolated idiopathic anterior uveitis. ORPHA:280914
